scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete subset enumeration and all-pairs exchange-distance computation using two standalone independently implemented codepaths. The computations establish the finite claim, not publication priority or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result for the five-regular, sixteen-vertex Clebsch graph only; not an all-dimensional theorem for folded cubes. Graph parameters, independent-set polynomial data and reconfiguration definitions are background, not novelty. Equivalent results in unindexed literature may exist. Independent scholarly audit has not been conducted.
title: The Clebsch domination-exchange threshold: frozen optima and diameter-five mobility
